name: Usulelo lomgudu womchamo (UTI)
tagline: Okuqhelekileyo kwabasetyhini. Amayeza okubulala iintsholongwane afunekayo. Sukuzihoya.

urgent.heading: Yiya ekliniki okanye esibhedlele ngokukhawuleza ukuba
urgent.primary_message: Usulelo olulula lwesinyi lunokusasazeka kwiintso kunye negazi. Iimpawu ezingezantsi zithetha ukuba usulelo luqhubekile - lufuna unyango ngokukhawuleza.
red_flags: Umkhuhlane ophezulu, ukungcangcazela, okanye ukubila kunye neempawu ze-UTI
Intlungu ebuhlungu emqolo okanye ecaleni (ejikeleze izintso)
Ukudideka okanye ukozela kakhulu - ngakumbi kubantu abadala
Iimpawu ze-UTI ekukhulelweni - ungaze ulinde ngaphandle
Iimpawu ze-UTI endodeni (ezingaqhelekanga, zihlala zibi kakhulu)

what_is_it.heading: UTI ngokwemiqathango ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: Usulelo lomjelo womchamo lwenzeka xa ibhaktheriya - idla ngokuphuma emathunjini - ingena kwinkqubo yomchamo kwaye iphindaphindeka. Uninzi luchaphazela isinyi (cystitis). Ngamanye amaxesha bafikelela kwizintso (pyelonephritis), eyingozi kakhulu.
paragraphs: Ii-UTIs zixhaphake kakhulu kwabasetyhini kuba ityhubhu yomchamo (urethra) imfutshane, ngoko ke iintsholongwane zifikelela kwisinyi ngokulula. Malunga nesiqingatha abasetyhini ubuncinane enye UTI ebomini babo. I-UTIs emadodeni, abantwana, okanye ukukhulelwa ayixhaphakanga kwaye ifuna ingqalelo esondeleyo.

Uninzi lwe-UTIs yesinye esilula lucaca ngokukhawuleza ngekhosi emfutshane yamayeza okubulala iintsholongwane. Ukunganyangwa, banokusasazeka ukuya phezulu kwiintso, apho usulelo luba lukhulu kakhulu - ngamanye amaxesha lubeka ubomi esichengeni. Musa ukuzihoya iimpawu ngethemba lokuba ziya kuhamba.

items.headline: Isiqingatha sabasetyhini
items.body: Baya kuba ne-UTI ubuncinane enye ebomini babo. Abaninzi baye abaninzi. Sesinye sezizathu eziqhelekileyo zokundwendwela eklinikhi.

items.headline: Ii-antibiotics ziyasebenza
items.body: Uninzi lwee-UTIs ezilula zicacile kwiintsuku ezi-2-3 kwikhosi emfutshane ye-antibiotic. Sela amanzi amaninzi ecaleni kwawo.

items.headline: Inokusasaza
items.body: I-UTIs enganyangwayo inokunwenwela kwizintso - i-pyelonephritis. Oku kubangela umkhuhlane, intlungu yomqolo, kwaye ngamanye amaxesha i-sepsis. Ingxakeko yokwenyani.

items.headline: Chama emva kokwabelana ngesondo
items.body: Ukwabelana ngesondo yinto eqhelekileyo ye-UTIs kubasetyhini. Ukuchama kwimizuzu engama-30 kukhupha iintsholongwane. Umkhwa wokuthintela lula imihla ngemihla.

pull_quote.text: Musa ukuzama ukunyanga iimpawu ze-UTI ngejusi ye-cranberry kunye namanzi kuphela. Banokunceda ukuthintela usulelo oluzayo kodwa abayi kulususa olusebenzayo. Fumana amayeza okubulala iintsholongwane - unyango kwangoko luthintela ukubandakanyeka kwezintso.

signs.heading: Indlela yokuxelela into onayo
signs.lede: I-UTIs yesinyi kunye nee-UTIs zezintso zabelana ngeempawu ezithile - kodwa ii-UTIs zezintso zongeza umkhuhlane kunye neentlungu zomqolo. Umahluko ubalulekile kakhulu.

items.title: Isinyi UTI (cystitis)
items.description: Ukutshisa xa uchama, kufuna uchama rhoqo, kufuneka uchame ngokukhawuleza kodwa kuphuma amanani amancinci kuphela, umchamo onamafu okanye onukayo, ukungakhululeki kwe-pelvic okanye emazantsi esisu. Akukho fever.

items.title: Izintso UTI (pyelonephritis)
items.description: Konke oku kungasentla kwe-PLUS fever, ukungcangcazela, iintlungu eziqatha emqolo okanye ecaleni, isicaphucaphu kunye nokugabha. Oku kufuna unyango olungxamisekileyo - ngamanye amaxesha esibhedlele.

items.title: UTI ngamaqela akhethekileyo
items.description: Ukukhulelwa, abantwana, abantu abadala, kunye namadoda - i-UTIs ingaba yinto engabonakaliyo (ukudideka kubantu abadala, ukucaphuka nje kwiintsana) kunye nokubi kakhulu. Hlala ujongwa.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokunciphisa amathuba akho
prevention.lede: Ukuba ufumana i-UTIs ephindaphindiweyo, imikhwa yemihla ngemihla yenza umahluko wokwenyani. Izinto ezincinci, zenziwe rhoqo.

items.title: Sela amanzi amaninzi
items.description: Injongo ye-1.5-2 ilitha ngosuku, ngakumbi kwimozulu eshushu okanye ngokuzilolonga. Umchamo ohlanjululweyo kunye nokugungxulwa rhoqo kugcina iintsholongwane zingaphindaphindeki.

items.title: Chama xa kufuneka
items.description: Musa ukuyibamba. Chama ngokupheleleyo — sukungxama. Ukubamba umchamo kunika iintsholongwane ixesha lokuphindaphinda kwisinyi esishushu, esimnyama.

items.title: Chama kwimizuzu engama-30 emva kokwabelana ngesondo
items.description: Ukhupha iibhaktheriya ezinokuthi zingene ngexesha lokwabelana ngesondo. Mhlawumbi eyona mkhwa isebenzayo yokuthintela yabasetyhini ababelana ngesondo.

items.title: Sula umphambili ukuya ngasemva
items.description: Ngokukodwa emva kokuhamba kwamathumbu. Ikhusela iintsholongwane emathunjini ekufikeni kwityhubhu yomchamo-owona mthombo uxhaphakileyo we-UTI bacteria.

items.title: Yiya ekliniki ufumane amayeza okubulala iintsholongwane afanelekileyo
items.description: Isimahla kuyo nayiphi na ikliniki karhulumente. Uvavanyo lomchamo luqinisekisa usulelo. Ikhosi emfutshane yamayeza okubulala iintsholongwane (idla ngokuba ziintsuku ezi-3-5) icoca uninzi lwe-UTIs. Musa ukuzama ukuyikhupha.

items.title: Sela amanzi amaninzi
items.description: Ngokukodwa ngelixa iimpawu zisebenza. Inceda ukugungxula iintsholongwane, inciphisa intlungu xa uchama. Jonga ubuncinane iilitha ezi-2 ngosuku ngexesha losulelo.

items.title: Gqibezela ikhosi yokubulala iintsholongwane - nokuba kungcono
items.description: Uninzi lwabantu luziva ngcono kwiiyure ezingama-24-48. Ikhosi epheleleyo yinto ephelisa ibhaktheriya kwaye inqande ukubuya. Ukuyeka ukuxhathisa kwemfuyo kwangethuba.

items.title: Ukuba umkhuhlane okanye intlungu ibonakala - hamba ngaphandle kokulibazisa
items.description: Oku kuthetha ukuba usulelo lufikelele kwizintso. Ifuna unyango olungxamisekileyo olunamandla - ngamanye amaxesha esibhedlele. Musani ukulinda kude kube kusasa.

items.title: Ukuba ufumana i-UTIs rhoqo - bonana nogqirha
items.description: Ii-UTI eziqhubekayo (3+ ngonyaka) zifuna uphando. Kusenokubakho unobangela osisiseko onyangekayo, kunye neendlela zokuthintela ixesha elide zikhona.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: I-UTIs sesinye sezizathu eziqhelekileyo zokuba abantu batyelele iikliniki. Unyango lusimahla, luyakhawuleza, kwaye luyasebenza—akukho mfuneko yakuva ubunzima.

helplines.name: I-i-ambulensi kaxakeka
helplines.description: Kwi-UTI yezintso ezinomkhuhlane ophezulu, iintlungu ezibuhlungu zomqolo, okanye ukugabha

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Uvavanyo lomchamo lwasimahla, uvavanyo, kunye ne-antibiotics
helplines.meta: Akukho kuqeshwa · akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo
